_doc: Riverbend Physical Therapy new-patient intake policy (fictional). Code in src/policy.js applies this file; the voice agent never decides eligibility itself.

service_area._doc: Houston-area ZIP prefixes and cities. Outside this, decline politely and suggest finding a PT clinic near them.

red_flags._doc: Any of these means: no booking, tell the caller to call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room now. Matched in code against everything the caller described, not only the model's own flag.

not_pt._doc: Requests physical therapy does not handle. Politely decline and suggest the right kind of provider. No booking.

decisions.book: Eligible. Offer evaluation slots and book.
decisions.book_self_pay: Eligible as self-pay. Quote the self-pay price, and book only if the caller agrees.
decisions.need_referral: HMO with no referral on file. Do not book. Explain a referral from their primary care doctor is needed first, and request a callback.
decisions.need_claim_number: Work injury with no claim number. Do not book. Ask them to get the claim number from their employer or adjuster, and request a callback.
decisions.er_now: Red-flag symptom. Do not book. Tell the caller to call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room now.
decisions.decline_not_pt: Not a physical therapy request. Do not book. Politely explain and suggest the right kind of provider.
decisions.out_of_area: Caller lives outside the Houston area. Do not book. Politely suggest a clinic closer to them.
decisions.need_info: Missing required details. Ask for them, then check coverage again.
